title: Agent segment
description: An agent's identity recorded as relations. Implements D3 (identifiers by decision) and D4 (continuity accounting), field names as in the catalogue.

segment_id.description: Assigned identifier, unique by assignment (for example a UUID), never derived from attributes.

parent_ids.description: D4: forks open segments with parent links; merges keep every parent.

items.description: Notes or artifacts carried across sessions. A predecessor's notes are testimony, quarantined unless signed under its segment identifier.

principal.description: A named, accountable person or office. Never the system itself.

ledger_thread.description: The action-ledger thread this segment writes into.
